title: Engine socket control message
description: A text WebSocket message on the engine's socket to the Vault (wss://relay.basaltvault.app/v1/engines/<engineId>), at most 4 KiB. Session bytes never travel here: they are binary ROUTE messages. Nothing here is authenticated end to end; the engine treats every Vault message as untrusted. A message that is not one of these shapes closes the socket with PROTOCOL. See CONTRACT.md, Vault channel, The engine's socket to the Vault.

challenge.description: Vault to engine, first message on a new socket.
32 random bytes, base64url; single use, valid 30 seconds.

sig.description: ECDSA P-256 (r||s, base64url) by the engine's signing key over "basalt-vault-engine.1\n" + challenge + "\n" + host, host being the engine's own Vault host.

ready.description: Vault to engine: authenticated; the engine now registers every live link again.

registerLink.description: Engine to Vault: route page sockets for linkToken to this engine until expiresAt. Idempotent for the same engine.

expiresAt.description: The link's expiry; the Vault refuses one more than 24 hours and 5 minutes ahead (INVALID_EXPIRY) and drops the token at that time.

unregisterLink.description: Engine to Vault: stop routing linkToken and close its open page sockets with LINK_UNKNOWN.

ok.description: Vault to engine: the request ref succeeded.

error.description: Vault to engine: the request ref failed, or (without ref) the last message was refused.

code.description: LINK_CONFLICT: another engine registered the token. LINK_LIMIT: too many live links for this engine. INVALID_EXPIRY: expiresAt past or too far ahead. UNKNOWN_SESSION: a ROUTE or SESSION_CLOSE for a sid the Vault does not know. RATE_LIMITED: too many requests. PROTOCOL: malformed.

sessionOpen.description: Vault to engine: a page connected to /v1/links/<linkToken>. Its handshake message 1 follows as a ROUTE message.

sessionClose.description: Either way: the session ended. The Vault closes the other side's socket with the same code.

ref.description: Picked by the engine, unique among its requests still waiting for an answer.

sid.description: 16 random bytes chosen by the Vault per page socket, base64url; the same 16 bytes head every ROUTE message of that session.

linkToken.description: HKDF-SHA-256(link secret, empty salt, info basalt-vault-link.1, 16 bytes), base64url.
